scripts.dev: bun --watch ./src/index.ts -- serve & VITE_API_BASE_URL= bun run --cwd ../pstdio-dashboard dev & wait
scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --banner "#!/usr/bin/env node" --external react
scripts.analyze-bundle: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --banner "#!/usr/bin/env node" --external react --metafile=./dist/bundle-meta.json --metafile-md=./dist/bundle-meta.md
scripts.build:bundle: bun run build && mkdir -p dist/api && cp -r ../pstdio-dashboard/dist ./dist/dashboard && cp ../pstdio-api/dist/index.js ./dist/api/server.js
